async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the 'Project name' textbox from the accessibility tree
    title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    # Get the current value
    current_value = await title_field.input_value()
    # If the current value is not 'GIVE ME SPACE', update it
    if current_value != 'GIVE ME SPACE':
        await title_field.fill('')
        await title_field.fill('GIVE ME SPACE')
    # Locate the 'Save changes' button, scoping to main to avoid ambiguity
    save_button = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Save changes')
    # If still ambiguous, use first match
    if await save_button.count() > 1:
        save_button = save_button.first
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the save to complete and page to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for UI to settle
    # No further actions needed; task is complete
